stories.title: Game Day Kickoff: Knee-jerk reactions and September lies; what does Week 4 have in store?
stories.summary: Week 4 will tell us if our knee-jerk reactions to the first few weeks of the season actually mean anything.

stories.title: 49ers' Juszczyk fined for 'offensive' act of pretending to chug beer
stories.summary: The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926 on Thursday for "engaging in offensive demonstrations."

stories.title: Cubs' Crow-Armstrong becomes 7th to join 40 HR-40 SB club
stories.summary: Cubs star Pete Crow-Armstrong became the seventh player in MLB history to join the 40/40 club after stealing his 40th base of the season on Thursday.

stories.title: Porter: 'Definitely' will play for Steelers in '26, exactly when TBD
stories.summary: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. said he is "definitely" going to play this season, but the exact date of his return to the field is still up in the air.

stories.title: Presti: Not expecting OKC downturn despite offseason departures
stories.summary: Oklahoma City GM Sam Presti said the Thunder could be as good as past teams despite key offseason departures.
